sample_rule: Predeclared purposive cross-sector current-vintage CN large liquid names, not historical index membership or PIT stock selection; no performance screening. First three pilot, then all twelve regardless of returns. All TREND. Exclude user nine holdings. No outcome-driven replacement.

excluded.HK: Separate later coverage; factor/calendar/execution still required

trial_contract.selection: one prespecified engineering baseline; no performance-based parameter choice or automatic promotion

execution.signal: completed_close; never same-bar fill or stop-price fill
execution.fill: first later session open with explicit side-specific executable evidence and settlement eligibility; otherwise pending/unknown
execution.intrabar: daily OHLC cannot establish event ordering; close-only rule, intrabar breach diagnostic not a fill
execution.cost_status: exploratory all-in commission/tax/slippage scenario, not verified broker tariff

trial_contract.industry: explicit market-matched benchmark + membership known_at required; unknown is not zero or veto

group_B.candidate_set: same audited frozen scope; no discovery expansion

trial_contract.promotion: candidate -> shadow -> validated -> active requires independent research signoff; development approval is not efficacy approval

A_entries: first old_trigger per common test fold, minimum 61 exchange sessions apart, irrespective of outcomes; identical entry episode all exits
folds: rolling train120 purge60 test60 stride120; no fit; all arms no fills beyond test end; terminal partial fold retained
execution: historical ex-post open realization, not forward known_at evidence; observed raw open strictly inside vendor buy/sell limit, positive daily volume, full calendar, missing price/limit/factor unknown stops order; no assumed price for missing bars; T+1 exchange sessions. conservative additionally blocks buy if high touches upper / sell if low touches lower. Missing bars split indicator state, not fabricated.
metrics: event adjusted-price returns, not portfolio; all statuses denominator; paired A closed intersections reported with censoring warning; no tuning
later_extension: HK feasibility only after all CN; no cost purchase
